theme.description: Panel colours: follow the system (default), always light, or always dark.

language.description: Panel language: the browser's (default), English, or Chinese.

colorTheme.description: Panel Theme: a Built-in Theme (teal, the default, leaf, celeste, claude or codex; the old sky reads as celeste) or a Theme File in <config>/themes (spec §3.34).

hotkey.description: The shortcut that opens the menu bar item from anywhere, such as `opt+x` (default), or `off`.

menubar.description: The Menu Bar Item on macOS (spec §3.31).

preferred.description: The terminal sideby opens for AI Tasks; without it sideby picks the one you use.

custom.description: Your own launch command for `preferred: custom`, with `{cwd}` and `{cmd}` placeholders.

terminal.description: The terminal AI Tasks open in (spec §3.28).

account.description: The account AI Tasks start (`<family>:<name>` or a short command); sideby picks one without it.

args.description: Host arguments sideby starts the account with; `sideby config` and `sideby model` set only the model and effort ones.
Host arguments `sideby run <alias>` adds after the Account `args`, before the user’s.

aliases.description: Short shell function names created by `sideby shell-init`, mapped to an Account ref or to `{ account, args }`.

pickCommands.description: Pick Commands: short shell function names created by `sideby shell-init`, mapped to a Family. Each run starts the Account of that Family with the most Quota left, or the Main Account when none has Quota data (ADR-0035). They share one namespace with `aliases`.

ignore.description: Account refs that are not Accounts.

pluginDirs.description: Absolute or `~/` paths of Plugin directories.

plugins.description: Per-Plugin settings; `enabled: false` turns a Plugin off.

extraSharedItems.description: Per family, more items each account shares with the main account: `{ path, mode }` with a relative path.

accountTitle.description: Set the terminal title to `[<short command or account>]` when sideby starts an Account, and keep Hosts that allow it (Codex) from replacing it. Off by default.

claudeMod.description: Load sideby's Claude Code mod (`--plugin-dir`, Claude Code 2.1.287 or later) when sideby starts a Claude Code account: a band with the Session Label, a toast when a Message arrives and a `/sessions` pane. On by default; false turns it off.

resumeRouting.description: Make `sideby shell-init` also define Host-named functions (`claude`, `codex`, `grok`) that resume a session by id in the Account that holds it. Off by default.

auto.description: Hand a running session to the next account when its Quota runs low: within the family only with `sameFamily`, to other families only with `otherFamilies`, to API accounts only with `api`. Off by default.

sameFamily.description: Also hand off to an account of the same family (cc001 → cc002). The kind vendors are most likely to act on. Off by default.

otherFamilies.description: When no account of the family can take over, let accounts of other families take over, family by family in `familyOrder`. Off by default.

familyOrder.description: Families to try with `otherFamilies`, first to last (for example ["codex", "grok"]); families left out come after, in the usual order.

api.description: Let API accounts take over as the last resort, when no subscription account can. They are billed per use and sideby does not cap spending. Off by default (ADR-0046).

prepareAt.description: Quota Pressure at which the session starts keeping a Handoff Brief (default 80).

threshold.description: Quota Pressure at which the Handoff begins (default 95). With `adaptive`, a window uses it until the run has measured a turn of it.

adaptive.description: Hand over by each window’s own pace: when it has less room left than 1.5 times its largest recent turn, between `prepareAt` and 99 (default true; ADR-0032). False uses `threshold` for every window.

waitIfResetWithinMinutes.description: Stay and wait when the full window resets within this many minutes (default 30; 0 never waits).

countdownSeconds.description: Countdown before the next account starts; Enter cancels (default 10; 0 skips it).

crossOrganization.description: Accounts (ref or short command) that may take over from an account of another organization.

policy.description: `pressure` picks the account with the most Quota left; `order` follows `order`.

order.description: Accounts (ref or short command) to try, in order.

families.description: Handoff Order per family the session starts in: `pressure` (default) or an `order` list.

check.description: Ask the npm registry once a day whether a newer sideby exists, and say so after a command and in the Panel. On by default; `NO_UPDATE_NOTIFIER` or `SIDEBY_NO_UPDATE_NOTIFIER` also turn it off.

auto.description: Install a newer version by itself after a check, when no `sideby run` is running and the version is not a major one. Off by default.

index.description: Keep a local History Index of every Session's title, Project, typed prompts and model replies (never tool output) in sideby's state folder, so Session History opens and searches at once. On by default; false stops it and deletes the index.

signIns.description: Look in Google Chrome's local data for which browser user signed in to each Account's website (key names only, never cookies or passwords; nothing leaves this computer). Off by default.

choices.description: The Chrome browser user (its folder, such as `Profile 7`) the user chose for an Account, by ref. It replaces what sideby found for that Account; set with `sideby browser set` or the Panel.

families.description: Family ids in the order the Panel and `sideby list` show them; families not listed follow in their usual order.

accounts.description: Per family, account names (not refs or short commands) in the order they are shown; accounts not listed follow, main first, then by name.

pinned.description: Per family, the names of the accounts pinned to the top of their group, in the order they are shown; they lead the group in every sort. Resetting the order keeps them.

hiddenFamilies.description: Family ids hidden from the Panel, the menu bar and `sideby list` (spec §3.25). Display only: they can still be started and picked by a Handoff.

hidden.description: Per family, the names of the accounts hidden from the Panel, the menu bar and `sideby list`. Display only: they can still be started and picked by a Handoff.

display.description: Display Order (spec §3.25): the order you gave families and accounts in the Panel, the accounts you pinned, and what you hid. Display only: it never changes which account a Handoff picks.

check.description: Per family, whether sideby may ask for Quota in a way that costs a request (Grok: its own CLI asks xAI, at most every 15 minutes per account). On by default; `false` turns it off. Off in CI.

quota.description: Quota that sideby asks for (spec §3.26, ADR-0025).

shellInitFile.description: Absolute or `~/` paths of files sideby rewrites with the `sideby shell-init <shell>` output whenever it adds an Account or an alias; source the file from your shell rc.
